name: sentinel-skills
description: Defensive security playbooks for coding agents
author: mgkvibez

skills.name: threat-model
skills.summary: Build a threat model from the code that exists, ranked by reachability.

skills.name: triage-alert
skills.summary: Turn a scanner finding or CVE alert into patch, defer, mitigate, or dismiss.

skills.name: review-diff-for-vulns
skills.summary: Security-review a pull request diff for reachable vulnerabilities before merge.

skills.name: cve-research
skills.summary: Establish what a CVE does and whether a specific codebase is exposed to it.

skills.name: harden-service
skills.summary: Reduce exposed surface and verify deployment controls before going public.
